notes: Byte-identical copy of the author's date-math snippet (INTCK for rounded age, YRDIF for fractional age, DATDIF with a 30/360 basis for a day count between two literal dates). Fully self-contained -- no data dependency, no edits needed beyond the standard obs=100 autoexec cap. Only the DATDIF-derived daycnt=3 line (independent of today()) is pinned in expected.json to avoid brittleness against the age calculations, which depend on the current date.
